notes.title: 🕯️Usability Update
notes.notes:
New accessibility feature: Skip Game Level
Ideal for use when stuck on a level, you can find it in two places:

 Home/Help & Options/Accessibility
 If you fail more than 10 times in a level, the Accessibility button will show up when you pause the game.


Optimized keyboard and mouse controls:

 (Optional) Left mouse button to burn
 (Optional) Arrow keys to move the character


Support wider screen resolutions.

notes.title: Official Candleman Release Date
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thank you to everyone for all your support! We are pleased to announce that Candleman: The Complete Journey will release on 31st January 2018 (6pm PST). 

We are very excited to finally welcome everyone to experience the journey of the little candle!

For more information and all the latest news, please visit 

Facebook: CandlemanGame 

Twitter: @CandlemanGame.
